as_told.title: SAIC remote viewing and crash retrieval

plain: A company called SAIC (Science Applications International Corporation), based in Reston, Virginia, has openly studied unusual science such as exotic propulsion, anti-gravity and energy beams, and seems to have worked hand in hand with Stargate, the psychic spying programme of the CIA, the US Central Intelligence Agency. Michels says this in two episodes, calling it public information, and in the later one says SAIC inherited the CIA's remote viewing work (attempts to see distant places with the mind) and that Bobby Ray Inman, a man he says sat on the company's board, linked it to possible recovery of crashed UFOs. If so, a private contractor would sit at the meeting point of psychic research and UFO secrets.
